# Authority Engine

> Andrew Lam's public proof-of-work system for operations intelligence, supply chain analytics, applied AI and operational experimentation.

Canonical: https://authority-engine-app.vercel.app/

## Core pages
- / — Operations Intelligence Builder
- /about — Background, operating philosophy and credibility
- /insights — Evidence, case studies, experiments and decision frameworks
- /contact — Professional inquiries

## Principles
- Evidence is distinguished from demonstration.
- Synthetic experiments are labelled as synthetic.
- Prototypes are not presented as production systems.
- Operational claims should be inspectable and decision-relevant.

## Current frontier
Open Aqua explores whether continuous low-cost sensing and sensor fusion can reveal aquarium risk earlier than periodic testing alone.
